title: Phase 1: Python architecture inventory and policy
status_detail: Human response `accepted and closeout authorized` accepts the completed bounded Phase 1 result and authorizes managed administrative closeout. The accepted result includes the reproducible architecture inventory, human-authorized Option B policy, prioritized candidate register, exact overlap and route-decision inputs, and clean Sphinx dummy/HTML warnings-as-errors gates. D4-D6 remain deferred and D7 remains conditional. This closure does not claim production refactoring, numerical or scientific validation, protected execution, release status, or successor activation; the parent and all five successor phases remain inactive.
objective: Establish the reproducible source-architecture inventory and accepted policy needed to plan refactoring without inferring responsibility from file size or naming alone.
authorized_scope: Inventory maintained modules, classes, methods, module-level callables, supported exports, deep-import consumers, dependency edges, cycles, responsibility clusters, large owners, and existing Protocol or abstract-class relationships using reproducible read-only analysis.
Define the supported package and subpackage import contract, the compatibility posture for existing exports, and the distinction between a non-exported implementation name and a supported public API.

Define the exact treatment of dangling callables, underscore-prefixed classes and methods, owner-local mechanical behavior, framework-required entry points, cross-object private calls, and method visibility on exported classes.

Define evidence-based separation-of-concern and abstraction criteria, prioritize refactor candidates, identify overlaps with existing managed Tasks, and propose later phase child boundaries without creating or activating them automatically.

Correct only the three pre-existing MyST navigation links in docs/research/index.md whose existing repository targets are excluded from or outside the Sphinx source tree, using canonical repository GitHub blob/dev URLs without changing link labels or target content.
completion_criteria: A reproducible, bounded architecture inventory classifies each reported signal without treating line count alone as a defect.

Material public-import, compatibility, callable-ownership, private-owner, module-boundary, and abstraction policies are explicit, mutually consistent, and resolved by the applicable human authority where alternatives remain.
A prioritized candidate register maps each proposed refactor to its current owner, consumers, contracts, verification surfaces, dependencies, and required future Task boundary.
Applicable planning documentation and Harness projections agree, residual uncertainties are explicit, and no implementation or automatic successor activation occurs.
exclusions: Do not refactor production source, rename supported objects, shrink exports, add conformance enforcement, or create package-specific implementation Tasks during the inactive recording or without separate activation.
Do not classify all large files, private methods, shared method names, or deep imports as defects without semantic ownership and contract evidence.
Do not alter scientific meaning, numerical policy, serialized contracts, dependencies, tests merely to change structure, or retained evidence identities.
No protected execution, release, or automatic phase activation is authorized; staging, commit, and push are limited to the exact validated managed closeout authorized by the recorded human response.
